name: motion-graphics
title_zh: 片头字幕、人名条、角标，它按时间码一帧帧画给你
tagline_zh: 视频剪辑到一半，要加字幕条却不想开特效软件？它把「第几秒到第几秒显示什么字、什么动画」变成确定性的渲染指令，标题。
tagline_en: Need a deterministic way to burn in titles or logos at exact timestamps? It renders title cards, lower thirds.
desc_en: Deterministic motion-graphics rendering execution Skill for the AI Video Production Ecosystem. Use it when a caller (normally video-production-agent) has already decided what graphic to show, when to show it, and roughly how it should look, and needs it rendered safely: title cards, lower thirds, free-form text overlays, and image/logo overlays, with built-in template animation (title/lower-third
why_zh: 它不猜你要什么，只执行你已定好的画面与时间。确定性渲染意味着同一输入永远同一输出，剪辑管线里可预期。
why_en: Deterministic by design: same input, same frames, every time. Built for an AI video pipeline where a planner decides what/when.
limit_zh: 只认四种元素：标题卡、人名条、自由文字、图片/Logo 叠加；动画仅限内置模板，自定义动效或 3D 场景它不接。
limit_en: Only 4 element types (title card, lower third, free text, image/logo) with built-in template animation. No custom motion or 3D. Outputs rendered.
title_en: Title cards, lower thirds, and overlays rendered.
